initialBuild.title: Archer / AFK (~35)
initialBuild.description:
That's how your build should roughly look when pushing for subclass.

## Calm_Basics

*1 = As much as you need to reach the farthest monster zone. Your goal is to reach Crabcakes to choose your subclass. For gaining levels, Sticks is a great farming zone.
After improving Accuracy prioritise "Sharpened axe" > "Gilded Sword", keep them within 10 levels of each other.

## Archer

Level "Polymer Limbs" to 50, active damage skills to 20, and then 1 value point into "Strafe". Activate it before going offline. Afterwards, level up "Have Another" to 10. Excess points can be used to level "Polymer Limbs" past 50.
